name: Clean Note Example
description: Entry-only note formatter that trims line whitespace and excess blank lines while preserving paragraphs.
author: covel-ai
notes: Official composable-notes example. Provides the examples.note-format@1 service; version 2.0.0 requires Notes Workbench 2.0.0 or later. Install independently and approve server code per session.

zh-CN.name: 笔记清理示例
zh-CN.description: 纯 entry 格式化服务：清理行首行尾空白与多余空行，保留段落。
zh-CN.notes: 官方组合记录示例，提供 examples.note-format@1 服务；2.0.0 须与记录工作台 2.0.0 及以上配合。须单独安装并在会话中授权服务端代码。
